items.title: Implement G04 stale-evidence baseline group
items.context: Add a deterministic G04 smoke where all 15 rows carry stale closure evidence; the rollup must report no full roadmap claim and staleEvidenceRows=15.
items.userSees: parent-roadmap large-ledger G04 baseline smoke PASS

happy.desc: Running the G04 smoke reports 15 required rows, zero closed rows, 15 stale evidence rows, and no full roadmap completion claim.

edge.desc: The smoke asserts each stale row carries closureEvidence but mismatched stale material/story/head binding and reason code stale_closure_evidence.

adversarial.desc: The smoke asserts full completion wording is blocked while all evidence is stale, even though every required row is present.

items.title: Implement G05 deferred-rows baseline group
items.context: Add a deterministic G05 smoke where 12 rows close and 3 rows are validly deferred; the rollup must keep no full roadmap claim and expose deferredRows=3.
items.userSees: parent-roadmap large-ledger G05 baseline smoke PASS

happy.desc: Running the G05 smoke reports 15 required rows, 12 implementation-closed rows, 3 deferred rows, and no full roadmap completion claim.

edge.desc: The smoke asserts the three deferred rows carry valid human approval, revisit conditions, non-runtime statements, and appear in deferredRows rather than disappearing.

adversarial.desc: The smoke asserts human-approved deferrals do not permit full roadmap completion wording or silently count as implemented runtime delivery.

items.title: Implement G06 migration-sample baseline group
items.context: Add a deterministic G06 smoke where all 15 rows are migration/sample-only and cannot count as real parent completion evidence.
items.userSees: parent-roadmap large-ledger G06 baseline smoke PASS

happy.desc: Running the G06 smoke reports 15 migration/sample rows, migrationRows=15, migration_needed, and no full roadmap completion claim.

edge.desc: The smoke asserts migration/sample rows remain open parent-governed rows and cannot become real closure evidence.

adversarial.desc: The smoke asserts legacy schema or migration metadata cannot be summarized as a completed current roadmap.

items.title: Implement G07 overclaim-boundary baseline group
items.context: Add a deterministic G07 smoke where local rows are otherwise closed but forbidden Authority/fullAuthority/production/independent-host wording is rejected by claim-boundary checks.
items.userSees: parent-roadmap large-ledger G07 baseline smoke PASS

happy.desc: Running the G07 smoke reports 15 local closed rows while the overclaim guard blocks Authority, fullAuthority, production, and independent-host completion wording.

edge.desc: The smoke asserts safe local claim boundaries pass the guard while elevated claim-boundary text is rejected before any full completion claim is accepted.

adversarial.desc: The smoke asserts local deterministic proof cannot be converted into Authority, production, fullAuthority, or independent two-host proof claims.

items.title: Implement G08 duplicate-or-malformed-row baseline group
items.context: Add a deterministic G08 smoke proving duplicate or malformed row IDs create invalid rows and cannot satisfy multiple user commitments.
items.userSees: parent-roadmap large-ledger G08 baseline smoke PASS

happy.desc: Running the G08 smoke reports invalidRows>0 and no full roadmap completion claim for duplicate or malformed row coverage.

edge.desc: The smoke asserts a duplicate generated row cannot cover the missing required row and malformed row shape is surfaced as invalid.

adversarial.desc: The smoke asserts a ledger with 15 generated entries still fails if those entries do not uniquely and validly cover all 15 required row IDs.

items.title: Implement G09 child-assignment-without-delivery baseline group
items.context: Add a deterministic G09 smoke proving assignment to child stories is not delivery; incomplete/open child rows prevent full roadmap completion.
items.userSees: parent-roadmap large-ledger G09 baseline smoke PASS

happy.desc: Running the G09 smoke reports child-story-assigned rows remain incomplete/open and no full roadmap completion claim is allowed.

edge.desc: The smoke asserts child-story-active rows with childStoryId are not delivery and produce child_story_active reason codes plus next actions.

adversarial.desc: The smoke asserts assigning every row to child stories cannot be summarized as delivered without closure evidence.

items.title: Implement G10 stale-then-refreshed recovery baseline group
items.context: Add a deterministic G10 smoke that first blocks stale evidence for all 15 rows, then refreshes evidence and permits full roadmap completion only after refresh.
items.userSees: parent-roadmap large-ledger G10 baseline smoke PASS

happy.desc: Running the G10 smoke first blocks 15 stale rows, then refreshes all 15 rows and permits full roadmap completion only after refresh.

edge.desc: The smoke asserts the before state has staleEvidenceRows=15 and the after state has 15 fresh closed rows, zero stale rows, and full_roadmap_complete.

adversarial.desc: The smoke asserts the recovery path cannot bypass stale evidence checks; only fresh material/story/head bindings unlock completion.

items.title: Bind all groups to full 10x15 aggregate baseline and docs
items.context: Add or update the full parent-roadmap large-ledger baseline smoke so G01-G10 generate exactly 150 evaluated rows; update docs to mark the full baseline implemented only after every group command and aggregate command pass.

happy.desc: Running the aggregate smoke reports all 10 groups represented, exactly 150 evaluated milestone rows, and the expected group matrix.

edge.desc: The aggregate smoke asserts only G01 and refreshed G10 permit a full roadmap claim, while G02-G09 remain blocked from full completion.

adversarial.desc: Documentation and aggregate checks must not claim full 10x15 completion until every group command and aggregate command pass, and must not claim Authority, production, fullAuthority, or remote two-host proof.
